newsitem.title: USA: N. Carolina high court hears school funding suit.
newsitem.headline: N. Carolina high court hears school funding suit.

text.p: The North Carolina Supreme Court heard oral arguments Thursday in a lawsuit challenging the state's school funding formula, but did not indicate when they would rule, a court clerk said.

Lawyers for five poor counties --- Cumberland, Hoke, Robeson, Halifax and Vance -- asked the court to reinstate their lawsuit challenging the distribution formula. They said the formula was inequitable and unconstitutional because it did not consider poor counties' inability to pay for educaton.
An state Appeals Court dismissed the lawsuit in March, ruling that the state constitution only mandates equal access to education but does not set a qualtiy standard.
If the state Suprme Court resinstates the lawsuit, it would be referred to a lower court for trial.
Attorneys for the state argued that the funding formula is constitutional because it is based on student population.
